conventions.convention: The quiver is finite and loopless, with arbitrary finite arrow multiplicities. Flags are increasing, and F^r/F^(r−1) has color ν_r. An arrow i→j contributes precisely the coefficient pairs ν_p=i, ν_q=j, q<p.

Line projectivization is Proj Sym(U∨), obtained from the supplier's quotient convention by dualizing. The compactification projectivizes W⊕O, and the chart t≠0 recovers the total space of W, including rank zero.
AC is assumed through the geometry and constructible-category suppliers. Zero dimension vectors, zero-dimensional vertex spaces and zero arrows are included; empty flag products are points.

For every characteristic-zero coefficient field, L_ν=Rπ_ν!k[d_ν], with d_ν the complex dimension of X_ν. Semisimple complex means a finite direct sum of shifts of simple equivariant perverse sheaves, rather than necessarily a perverse object. Finite-model perverse normalization uses the base dimension s_N.

load_bearing.statement: Assume AC. For a finite loopless quiver, a finite-dimensional complex graded space V and a word ν of its dimension-vector content, the increasing stable full-flag incidence X_ν is a G_V-equivariant vector subbundle of E_V×F_ν, of rank Σ_(h:i→j) #{(p,q):ν_p=i,ν_q=j,q<p} and dimension that rank plus Σ_i β_i(β_i−1)/2. Its projection to E_V is projective. Adjoining a trivial line and taking line projectivizations gives a G_V-equivariant projective map with smooth projective source restricting to the incidence projection on t≠0. The analogous tautological-bundle construction over finite products of complex Grassmannians gives a projective map between smooth projective varieties with the same affine-chart restriction.

Assume the inherited AC. For any finite loopless complex quiver with arbitrary finite arrow multiplicities, any finite dimension vector, every word ν of that content and every characteristic-zero coefficient field k, L_ν=Rπ_ν!k_Xν[d_ν] is a finite direct sum of shifts of simple G_V-equivariant perverse sheaves in the actual bounded equivariant constructible category. The finite sum over all such words is semisimple in the same sense. No semismallness, finite-ADE hypothesis or affine paving of the fibers is required.

seams_checked.note: Corollary F2 and step 1.1 use finite constant-coefficient cochain models only on closed projective flag fibers. The supplier covers these quasi-projective varieties and gives the required upper bound 2 dim_C; no arbitrary-map compatible triangulation is inferred.

Corollary F3–F9 and steps 1.1–5.1 preserve the actual Cartesian simplicial category, characteristic-zero and general-linear-group hypotheses, the bounded Hom threshold and the base-dimension shift s_N. Projectors lift through the endomorphism-ring comparison and idempotent completeness; arbitrary ordinary perverse objects are not assumed to descend.

Corollary F10 and step 3.1 apply the compact-source theorem to the explicit projective map between projective varieties with smooth source of dimension d_ν+s_N, then restrict to the affine chart. The supplier allows every characteristic-zero field without an embedding into C.

The downstream page's scope paragraph and global-basis theorem F4/step 2.1 faithfully consume semisimplicity for finite loopless multiedge quivers over characteristic-zero fields with L_ν=Rπ_ν!k[d_ν]. Negative Hom and division endomorphism rings are separately attributed to the perverse-heart supplier.
